text:
PSC::subscriber_id
Description
The PSC::subscriber_id command gets the subscriber id or sets the
subscriber_id when the optional value is given.
Syntax
PSC
::
subscriber_id
PSC
::
subscriber_id
<
subscriber_id
>
PSC::subscriber_id
retrieve the subscriber id
PSC::subscriber_id <subscriber_id>
set the subscriber id
